name: Flywheel Advanced Technology, Inc.
summary: Flywheel Advanced Technology, Inc. does not have significant operations. It intends to source the supply and sale of warehouse patrol robots. The company was formerly known as Pan Global Corp. and changed its name to Flywheel Advanced Technology, Inc. in November 2021. Flywheel Advanced Technology, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Carson City, Nevada.
